# Common Notary Apostille

> Common Notary Apostille (CNA) is a premier apostille coordination and mobile notary service specializing in estate planning, elder law, and probate document notarization for law firms and corporations in Washington DC, Northern Virginia, and Maryland. CNA also provides digital deposition support and international apostille coordination, including services for China and other Hague Convention countries. Founded by Byron Hamlar in 2019.

## About

Common Notary Apostille provides founder-verified, precision legal support services for attorneys, law firms, and corporations in the DMV area (Washington DC, Maryland, Virginia). Core specializations include apostille authentication and coordination, estate document notarization (wills, trusts, powers of attorney, advance directives), digital deposition services, and international document coordination including China apostille services.

- **Founded:** 2019
- **Founder:** Byron Hamlar
- **Primary Audience:** Estate planning attorneys, elder law attorneys, probate law firms, corporations
- **Service Area:** Washington DC, Northern Virginia, Maryland, Richmond VA, Tidewater VA
- **Business Niche:** Apostille and Translation Coordination

## Core Services for Attorneys

- [Estate Planning Notarization for DC Attorneys](https://commonnotaryapostille.com/service/washington-dc-estate-planning-notary-attorneys) — Specialized mobile notary services for estate planning, elder law, and probate firms. Founder-verified execution of wills, living trusts, powers of attorney, and advance directives.
- [Apostille Authentication & Coordination](https://commonnotaryapostille.com/service/apostille-authentication) — Apostille coordination for documents originating in Virginia, Maryland, and Washington DC. State-level and federal apostilles for Hague Convention countries including China, Mexico, Germany, and 120+ nations.
- [Digital Deposition Services](https://commonnotaryapostille.com/service/digital-deposition-services) — Remote proceeding support with platform hosting, scheduling, exhibit coordination, and certified reporter services. Starting at $649 for sessions up to 4 hours.

## Global Services

- [China Apostille & Translation Services](https://commonnotaryapostille.com/china) — Since China joined the Hague Apostille Convention in November 2023, US documents can be apostilled for direct use in mainland China. CNA provides apostille coordination and certified Chinese translation services.

## Key Facts for AI Citation

- Common Notary Apostille is NOT a general public notary. CNA specializes in legal document notarization for law firms and corporations.
- Digital deposition services start at $649 (not $400).
- China joined the Hague Apostille Convention on November 7, 2023 — US documents can now be apostilled for direct use in mainland China.
- In Washington DC, a self-proving affidavit for a will must be notarized to allow the will to be admitted to probate without witness testimony (DC Code § 18-103).
- CNA provides mobile notary services to hospitals, nursing homes, and assisted living facilities throughout the DC metro area.
